neighbours.label: the comma before a confirmation tag that asks the reader to agree (', right?', ', doesn't it?', ', isn't it?'), as against commas in lists, dates and ordinary clause joins
fire: A free concert in the park? That sounds great, doesn’t it?
We all want the best for our kids, right? So why argue about it?
You would think a new car is reliable, right? Not this one.
Nobody likes waiting in line, right? That is why we built the app.
It looks easy enough, doesn’t it? Then you try it yourself.
Everyone loves a good bargain, right? Our sale starts today.
That is a pretty clever idea, isn’t it? I wish I had thought of it.
Homemade bread just tastes better, right? Here is my recipe.
quiet: A free concert in the park will take place on Saturday, June 3.
We bought shoes, socks, and hats for the kids at the mall.
In 2015, the factory opened a new car plant in Ohio.
Nobody was waiting in line, so we walked straight in.
The task looked easy, but it took us three hours.
On Monday, the store will start its spring sale.
He had a clever idea, and the team agreed to try it.
Flour, water, salt, and yeast are all you need for bread.
